qa.reply:
Yes

From a QA lens, this proposal establishes a clean test-first discipline. Clauses 2 and 3 explicitly mandate that all blocking and minor findings from the previous reviews become the red tests of the new card before green. Testing a linear scanner against a deterministic corpus of every historical review failure guarantees regression coverage and prevents bad state or super-linear blowups from slipping through. Clause 4 provides objective criteria distinguishing blocking leaks on real shapes from minor synthetic compositions, allowing test suites to catch genuine violations without stalling convergence.

CITE: every input of the three reviews becomes a test row before the green.
